title: Loreverse
tagline: Loreverse enables anyone to create lore and fork what someone already wrote. And It enables anyone to count how many times the lore forked as on-chain data.
description:
This project focuses on NFT derivatives and reference feature.
In the NFT space, the adoption of CC0 is expanding, and many derivatives continue to be produced.
The information on how many times the NFT has been referred is very important and helps to evaluate the value of the NFT.
The number of citations for an academic paper is useful when assessing the value of the paper (h-index).
And Google's search engine does the same thing when evaluating websites.
Loreverse enables anyone to create lore and fork what someone already wrote. And It enables anyone to count how many times the lore forked as on-chain data.
how_its_made:
Loreverse enables anyone to create lore as a NFT.

And anyone can read and rewrite/refer/fork the lore.



1. You write a lore on Loreverse

2. You mint the as a NFT and receive it

3. The lore is listed on Loreverse, and anyone can read it

4. When someone fork the lore and write a derivative lore, this project adds a count +1 to original lore's "referred number" as on-chain data.

5. Derivative lore NFT holds a data which means what refer source is.

6. Loreverse enables anyone to count how many times the lore forked as on-chain data and that works like h-index in the academic space.



The system provides "derivatives graph" or "derivatives network" to NFT space.
